description: The node's bundles, each a named subset of the API, keyed by a number, each with an owner: "node" or the name of an app server. op add {label, owner?} answers {id}, owned by node when no owner, or an invalid one, is given; set {id, label} renames it, its owner never changes after the add; delete {id} removes it and every branch that names it; get {id} answers {id, label, owner}; search {text, owner?} answers {items, more}, an owner narrowing it to that owner's bundles. A label is never empty. Its branches are auth.branch's.
